title: IDDM1
description: id Deathmatch Pack #1 is a 26-level deathmatch megawad created for multiplayer play in Doom + Doom II. Designed by various authors, it includes maps co-authored by id Software's American McGee and Sandy Petersen. The set features a soundtrack with music from Doom, Doom II, TNT: Evilution, and Legacy of Rust.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release of Doom + Doom II (iddm1.wad).
